campaigns.title: Activation: signed up, no video in 48h

steps.subject: Your first video is 3 minutes away
steps.body: Hi! Pick a template and generate your first video - it takes ~3 minutes. We added {{tokens}} bonus tokens to get you started: {{app_url}}

steps.subject: A template picked for you
steps.body: Creators like you start with these 3 templates: {{app_url}}/templates

campaigns.title: Trial ends in <=3 days, not paid

steps.subject: Your trial ends soon - keep your videos
steps.body: Your trial ends in a few days. Upgrade to keep generating: {{app_url}}/pricing

steps.subject: We added 7 more days to your trial
steps.body: Need more time to decide? Your trial got +7 days. Try the Pro templates meanwhile: {{app_url}}/templates?tier=pro

steps.subject: Payment issue - your account is safe
steps.body: Your last payment did not go through (this is usually a card issue, not you). Update your card in 30 seconds: {{card_update_url}}. Your videos and tokens are safe.

steps.subject: Reminder: update your card to keep Pro
steps.body: Quick reminder to update your payment method: {{card_update_url}}. We retry automatically once it is updated.

steps.subject: Last call before your plan pauses
steps.body: We could not charge your card for 3 days. Update it now to avoid losing Pro features: {{card_update_url}}

campaigns.title: Save: activity dropped or cancel flow started

steps.subject: Need a break? Pause instead of cancel
steps.body: You can pause your subscription for a month - keep your tokens and history, pay nothing: {{app_url}}/account/pause

steps.subject: What you created this month
steps.body: Your stats: {{videos_month}} videos generated. Here is what is new since you last visited: {{app_url}}/whats-new

campaigns.title: Upgrade: power user at plan limit

steps.subject: You are hitting your plan limit
steps.body: You used most of your tokens this month. On Pro your cost per token is lower and renders are faster: {{app_url}}/pricing

steps.subject: 25% off if you switch to annual
steps.body: Lock in 25% off with the annual plan - for heavy months like this one: {{app_url}}/pricing?annual=1
